data.name: San Diego: Gaslamp Quarter Ghost Tour
data.headline: 1.5 Hours • PG-13 • Ghost Tour  • NEW!
data.description:
##Duration
1.5 Hour

##About
Experience the darker side of San Diego on this tour of the Gaslamp Quarter with tales of ghostly history. During this tour, you will visit several of the Gaslamp Quarter’s most popular local hauntings while learning of sinister spirits, disease, death, espionage and murder.

With many infamous ghosts there are several notable occurrences of haunting downtown San Diego. You will hear the thrilling stories of the spirits and have an opportunity to ghost hunt on several areas along the way.
